The album showcases the foundational sounds of reggae, featuring a curated selection of tracks that highlight the genre's evolution from its roots in ska and rocksteady. The musical style centers on classic reggae rhythms, characterized by offbeat guitar chops, prominent basslines, and socially conscious lyrics, capturing the essence of the label's influential catalog.

As part of Trojan Records' extensive discography, "This Is Trojan" serves as both a retrospective and an introduction to the label's legacy, which has been instrumental in popularizing reggae music worldwide. The album does not represent a new studio effort by a single artist but rather compiles seminal recordings that have shaped the genre. Upon its original release, the album was well-received for its historical significance and the quality of its track selection, appealing to both longtime fans and newcomers seeking an authentic overview of reggae's golden era.
